research_question: RQ-A2: What objective gaps, route counts, timeouts, infeasible results, and resource failures occur against cited best-known or proven reference values?

inspection_disclosure.limitation: This is not a blinded or data-generation-time preregistration. RQ-A2 and its no-positive-threshold boundary were frozen earlier in the Round 3 research contract; this manifest freezes deterministic aggregation before the R3-316 analyzer is implemented or materially executed.

source_double_bks.purpose: Reference direction, conditional source-distance gaps, and R3-317 outcome rates.

derived_conservative_integer_optimum.purpose: Exact transformed-model candidate gaps only. These values must never be pooled with source-double BKS gaps.

all_outcome_ledger.purpose: Prove that every upstream record is retained and assigned to exactly one analysis domain.

objective_semantics.same_vehicle_distance_gap_percent: 100 * (candidate_distance_2dp - reference_distance) / reference_distance, only when vehicle counts match and the reference is approved for scalar comparison
objective_semantics.transformed_exact_gap_percent: 100 * (candidate_transformed_distance - exact_transformed_distance) / exact_transformed_distance, only after equal vehicle count and proven exact status
objective_semantics.direction: Negative is better, zero is equal, and positive is worse for every numeric gap distribution.
objective_semantics.best_and_worst: Best is the minimum and worst is the maximum numeric gap.
objective_semantics.forbidden_scalarization: Vehicle count and distance must not be combined with a big-M, weighted sum, penalty, infinity imputation, or cross-domain scalar.

REFERENCE_QUALITY_REVIEW.reason: Questioned or marked reference values remain visible but cannot enter a numeric gap distribution.

REFERENCE_GAP_NOT_APPLICABLE.reason: No accepted incumbent or no admissible comparison exists.

descriptive_statistics.percentile_method: Hyndman-Fan Type 7 linear interpolation at position (n - 1) * q, with q = 0.90.
descriptive_statistics.inference: No p-value, confidence interval, population trend, equivalence, non-inferiority, superiority, or cross-domain pooled statistic is authorized.

outcome_accounting.exact_domain_accounting: Report exact status and candidate status counts separately; R3-315 has no R3-317 outcome denominator and must not be inserted into source timeout rates.

audit_invariants: Every input path is repository-relative, resolves below the repository root, and matches its frozen SHA-256.
Schema, task, manifest, selected, retained, and run counts match the frozen input contract.
Run identities are unique within each task and every one of the 42 records appears exactly once in the all-outcome ledger.
No run is excluded because of timeout, infeasibility, missing incumbent, poor objective, reference quality, or unfavorable direction.
Numeric source gaps are absent for REFERENCE_QUALITY_REVIEW and REFERENCE_GAP_NOT_APPLICABLE records.
Existing source distance gaps and exact transformed gaps are independently recomputed within 1e-9 absolute tolerance.
Source-double and derived conservative integer distributions remain separate.

gate_rule.engineering: E-PASS requires directed analyzer tests, full local gates, and a green implementation CI run.
gate_rule.experiment: X-PASS requires material execution against all three frozen input digests plus an immutable result and digest audit.
gate_rule.statistics: S-PASS requires all 42 records accounted, every denominator and Type-7 statistic reproduced, all omission reasons reported, and every domain/reference guard satisfied. It does not imply inferential support.
gate_rule.claim: C-NO-CLAIM is required because RQ-A2 has no positive quality hypothesis and the observed upstream outcomes cannot establish optimality, superiority, external validity, or population behavior.

execution_policy.material_gate: Commit this manifest and obtain green remote CI; then implement and obtain green remote CI before material analysis execution.

supported_wording: R3-316 may report deterministic descriptive gap and outcome summaries for the frozen retained inputs, with separate source-BKS and derived-exact domains and explicit omission reasons.
prohibited_wording: RouteMind is optimal or superior on Solomon or Gehring-Homberger.
A pooled scalar gap combines vehicle count, distance, source models, and transformed models.
Missing incumbents or questioned references were excluded from the benchmark denominator.
The fixed descriptive distributions establish a population trend or unrestricted solver capability.
